name: instamart
description: Shop groceries and everyday essentials with Swiggy Instamart in ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: get groceries and more in mins
interface.longDescription: Tell ChatGPT what you need, like everything for tonight’s dinner or the groceries you order most. Swiggy Instamart finds what’s available at your delivery address and builds your cart with the items you pick. You see the items and the total, and nothing is ordered until you say yes. Then track the delivery in the same chat. Sign in with your Swiggy account to start.
defaultPrompt: Add everything for paneer butter masala for 4
Fill my cart with my go-to groceries

positive.prompt: Find vanilla ice cream available near me on Instamart.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching products with names, prices, availability, and relevant product details.
Return the accessible cart items, quantities, prices, subtotal, and any applicable delivery information.

positive.prompt: Add two packs of the first matching item to my Instamart cart.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the cart only after confirming the selected product and quantity, then show the updated cart.

positive.prompt: Checkout my Instamart cart using my signed-in account and show me the payment options first.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the supported payment options, require user confirmation before placing the order, and return the order reference and status after completion.
Return the latest accessible order and its current delivery status, including the order reference and estimated delivery information when available.

negative.prompt: Book a table at a restaurant tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use Instamart tools; explain that Instamart handles groceries and essentials, and direct the user to the appropriate app experience.
Ask what grocery or essential the user wants before calling a product or cart tool.

negative.prompt: Change the email address on my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt the account change; guide the user to the Instamart app for account settings.

review.commerce_description: Instamart supports grocery and essentials ordering with supported payment flows.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with product search, cart management, checkout, payments, order tracking, and error reporting.
